title: Version 1.10.0 is treated as older than 1.9.0
issue: `compare_versions("1.10.0", "1.9.0")` returns -1 and `latest(["1.9.0", "1.10.0", "1.2.0"])` returns `1.9.0`. Version parts must be compared as numbers, not as text.

steps.say: I'll start with the module the issue is about.
Before changing anything I want to see what the existing tests cover.
parse_version returns the parts as strings, so the comparison is lexicographic and "10" sorts before "9".
Running the tests again to confirm nothing that worked before is broken.

args.summary: parse_version now returns integers, so versions are compared numerically.
